correctness.rationale: The cube is forward invariant, cooperative, and W1=1 allows exact scalar min/max bounding trajectories, proving equivalence with scalar root uniqueness for arbitrary directed/reducible W. Scalar G_beta(s)=logit(s)-beta*s has critical points q± only for beta>4, and at equality there are still two distinct constant equilibria. At critical a=-2,beta=4, exact tanh expansion -4u³/3+32u^5/15+O(u^7) implies z=u^-2 satisfies zdot=8/3-64/(15z)+O(z^-2) and z=(8/3)t-(8/5)log t+C+o(1). Independent Sympy series and beta=4.1,5,10 fold parameter checks confirm. For irreducible W, Perron eigenvalue 1 is simple and other eigenvalues have Re<1; diagonal exact center manifold and stable foliation give exponentially tracked common scalar phase, hence common C. No extension claimed to reducible W for logarithmic expansion.
